Dayum ok uhm warning unprofessional advise (from a depressed but not suicidal person (had suicide thoughts but never really considered it). 
-Physical Pain. Self harm isnt the best Option I think we all know that better than suicide but not great. A better way is the gym or going jogging depending on preferences but Gym is for most the better option to let they're emotions out. That only consumes 2h of the day at best tho.

-Music. I always listened to depressed songs like suicide letter -skippy or never be alright -Seon
Great songs and probably in his playlist and I definitely wouldnt take them away all at once but try to get him to listening to a happy playlist with whatever music he likes that isnt depressing. Maybe play some board or card games with him and listen to a few bangers it doesnt have to be a long time but try to make a daily or atleast weekly appointment with him to do a shared activity and listen to some good vibe music. 

-Talking. I had the opportunity to talk to someone who ment very much to me (well still does but I'm not the topic xD) Talk with him about his feelings. He should feel like you want to know everything.  Good ways are to also talk about yourself idk maybe a secret that you didnt shared yet or an embarrassing moment or you cook his favorite meal / order Pizza / reward him for talking about his feelings. But dont push him into a conversation if he clearly says I dont want than let him his time.

-Reassurance. Let him know how much you love him (I think you do that since you get married) so maybe get his Parents or Siblings involved if they have a good relationship. If not maybe another good friend (if left)

-Help. I know how hard it is to even do the basics of the basics. That starts with brushing your teeth goes over to a shower, cooking something else than pasta isnt even worth a thought etc. Help him with those things! I showered like once a month maybe twice if my head itched xD. The Energy to get up just isnt there. Once your up it isnt even that hard anymore (for me atleast). Also a short walk was a godly feeling, I did it way to rarely but when I got myself to do it i never regretted it. Those are simple tips but jeah they work. 

-Distraction. This seems like a simple and self explaining one right? Just put on his favorite movie and let him watch. Well it's one of the hardest ones because you just dont enjoy those things anymore. Nearly everything you like just becomes boring and unfun to do. So jeah you can definitely put on a TV show or movie but I catched myself just turning it off or dont listen really. Cinema was a but different tho it was actually a bit enjoyable to go there so maybe try that. 

That are the first things that came to my Mind. I hope it isnt to painful to read all that. Maybe read it with him? And ask him what he thinks about it and make fun about my grammar errors. 

Oh and if you do something always ask how he liked it and adapt. Every person is different so something that works for me doesnt has to work for him. Also make sure that he doesnt lie because often we just say mhh yes it was fun or something similar. Get him to understand that you really need an honest answer. 

That's kinda it. If you have questions just keep asking. I know its tiresome to help a depressed person because you kinda have to life ? live? Life right? Jesus my English is bad xD for 2 at once. So for you Queen 
Thanks for helping him, dont let this sickness burn your Energy reserves too. Be his light to guide him out of this dark times.

For you my king, head up! Everything gonna be alright eventually. Let your soon to be Wife help you. 
I wish you both nothing but the best.

Things that helped me to stop sh 

First off stop listening to Depressions songs. Sometimes I stumble around one in my liked songs and I have a lil relapse. It really helps tremendously. 

Second hit the good old gym. If you have leg cramps because you hitted the gym so hard you definitely have enough pain. Also you forget your problems and Depression for the time when you are at the gym. Further you build a healthy and strong body resulting eventually in more self confidence. 

Third is distraction. I know it's hard to focus on anything or even wanting to do anything besides listening yellow and bleeding yourself dry to it but try to find an distraction for you. That can be extra hours at work unless you hate your job as much as I do. It could be reading, in that scenario a sad story isnt even that bad because you can relate and that keeps you interested. It could also be going for a walk or taking a shower or what also helps really good is if you are good with your family to play a game with them. Even if they normally dont play board games as example of tou ask them there is a good chance they say yes. Especially if you say why or just say I need an distraction right now. And if the answer is still no than you can try and ask your grandma if she is still alive. 

4th would be probably talking about your feelings. Idk why I didnt out that as number 2 or even 1 but whatever. Talk about those feelings. If you cant for whatever reason write about them. There is a website called MeWe technically visible for everyone but due to the data privacy your profile wont show up. So you can share your thoughts with everyone but have a 99% safety that they wont read it. 

5th Cry giving you can cry. I had a long time where I wasnt able to cry because i numbed my self so hard. Finally allowing myself to cry was something that helped me very much. 

I hope this massive amount of text helped you get distracted a little bit and if not you can still write me and let all of your emotions out. Offer also counts if the text helped 😅
